note: τετραδράχμȣ: stacked ou-ligature (V-top over closed bowl), identical to the unambiguous ȣ in μεδίμνȣ on the line above; no accent. Matches opus/llama.

πανȣ͂ργος: glyph under the circumflex is the ou-ligature (closed round bowl under a V), plainly unlike the open V-shaped υ in τυφλά / πολυσχιδῆ in the same column. llama had the ligature but dropped the circumflex; opus/genie had the circumflex but a plain upsilon.
κακȣ͂ργος: same ligature+perispomeni as the preceding πανȣ͂ργος, two words to its left on the same line.

Two separate short iota strokes after the zeta: Ζιι = Historia animalium book 9. Bekker 619b15 sits in HA IX (608a-633b), inside the HA range 486-638, so llama's Ζμ (De part. an., 639-697) is impossible; opus dropped the second iota.
Αἰσώπȣ: final glyph is the bare ou-ligature (V over closed bowl), no accent and no iota subscript; not υ (opus) and not ῳ (genie).

πολλȣ̀ς ἐχȣ́σης: both disputed vowels are the ou-ligature, the first with a grave, the second with an acute. Compare the unmistakable alpha of κυνοραϊστὰς immediately before: quite a different shape, so genie/llama's alpha is wrong; opus's plain upsilon is the known ligature-to-upsilon failure.
γαλεοειδεῖς: the letter after omicron is a three-barred epsilon, matching the epsilon in γαλε- two letters earlier, not a lunate sigma. Matches genie/llama.

Alpha carries smooth breathing + acute (ἄ); the vowel after rho is the ou-ligature ȣ, not υ (opus) or ῳ (genie); the iota of περί clearly bears an acute before the line-break hyphen (contra genie/llama's περι). No single reader had all three.
A distinct baseline dot after ἅλ, the abbreviation point in the headword ἅλ.ωσις; genie/llama dropped it.
The mark after ωσις sits on the baseline (ink y=624-632) whereas the comma after ἅλωσις later on the same line descends below it (y=633-641) with a tail. It is a period, not a comma.
Superscript column letter in 340b5 is a clear b (straight ascender + bowl), unlike the a of 386a3 earlier on the line. Matches opus/llama.
Final ϗ carries a plainly printed grave stroke above it. genie's 'χωρὶς' is not what stands there; llama omitted the accent.
